name: Mold-Tek Technologies Ltd
title: Mold-Tek Technologies Ltd - 526263 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 PAT Rs2.3 cr despite Rs4 cr FX MTM hit; BIW/MES team cut 160→60 and Beryl acquisition adds ~Rs23 cr 5-month revenue, but FY26 EBITDA fell to Rs20 cr (11% margin) and management guides 15% margin without a numeric FY27 revenue commitment.

triggers.label: MES team cut 160→60
triggers.quote: downsize the team from 160 to 60 people gradually, and by end of March, the team has been downsized from 160 to 60

triggers.label: CES work on hand ~$5 mn, up 60-70%
triggers.quote: Today, the work on hand is close to $5 million. So, there is a jump of almost 60%-70%.

triggers.label: Receivables up sharply YoY
triggers.quote: our receivables also have jumped a lot on a year-on-year basis. They have basically doubled

triggers.label: EBITDA margin 11% → 15%+ target
triggers.quote: EBITDA margin should move from 11% to at least 15% is our projection.

guidance.quote: EBITDA margin should move from 11% to at least 15% is our projection.
hitting INR 250 crores I think is certainly possible.
this year, it should cross $1.5 million to $2 million.
I wish to see in 3-4 years at least 30%-40% of our revenues coming from design.
our target is to improve productivity by at least 20% in this financial year

red_flags.label: Receivables doubled YoY, Rs30 cr to Rs41 cr in 6 months
red_flags.quote: our receivables also have jumped a lot on a year-on-year basis. They have basically doubled

red_flags.label: Preferential issue cancelled by investor
red_flags.quote: the investor has taken a call not to invest in that $0.5 million which he committed

red_flags.label: Hedging losses hit earnings; policy being cut
red_flags.quote: limit the forwards only to 25%-50% of company's turnover. Earlier it used to be 100%.

red_flags.label: EBITDA figure disputed by analyst
red_flags.quote: I am looking at your consolidated cash flow statement before working capital changes it is showing INR 13.79 crores

evasions.quote: I will ask our CFO, Sarvesh, to answer to you later.
Maybe we didn't mention that. We will check-up on that.
Including Beryl, I can't comment because Beryl has not yet come for that discussion.
